# 🛠️ Maintenance Checklist

## Review metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Review date | |
| Revision | |
| Reviewer | |
| Scope | |
| Next review | |

## Source and repository hygiene

- [ ] Important files and assets are present.
- [ ] No unreviewed deletion or accidental generated files.
- [ ] Project tree and docs reflect the real repository.
- [ ] Markdown relative links resolve.
- [ ] SVG assets are valid and have titles/descriptions.
- [ ] Mermaid files are readable and linked from docs.

## Dependencies and security

- [ ] npm audit summary reviewed.
- [ ] Dependabot PRs reviewed.
- [ ] Critical/high advisories have an owner and remediation plan.
- [ ] Node and npm support windows reviewed.
- [ ] GitHub Actions versions and permissions reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets are present in current changes.

## Application quality

- [ ] Contract tests pass.
- [ ] Type check passes.
- [ ] Repository validation passes.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Manual route smoke tests recorded.
- [ ] Accessibility issues and browser compatibility reviewed.

## Documentation and governance

- [ ] README and docs hub are current.
- [ ] Architecture and data-flow diagrams match source.
- [ ] Known issues and technical debt are updated.
- [ ] Roadmap items are still relevant.
- [ ] Issue and PR templates are useful.
- [ ] License and attribution boundaries remain accurate.
